properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency of the Ethereum dev toolchain (eth-sig-util → ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 declares hash.js at package-lock.json:11640); no first-party call site — dependency-inventory entry, dev-only, changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: crypto-js@3.3.0 is a transitive dependency of the Ethereum dev toolchain and ships the MD5 implementation in the build's node_modules; MD5 is collision-broken and quantum-unsafe.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dependency of ganache (local dev blockchain); SHA-1 is collision-broken. Dev toolchain only; changeable here via dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 is this project's core curve: the first-party contracts verify ECDSA-secp256k1 on-chain (OffchainAllowlistExtension via OpenZeppelin SignatureChecker; vendored Rarible ExchangeV1 via ecrecover) and the deployment accounts are secp256k1 keys (BIP-39 mnemonic accounts in hardhat.config.ts, raw env private-key wallets in scripts/helpers.ts). Shor-vulnerable signature curve; migration is ecosystem-wide (no PQ account scheme on-chain yet). Changeable here only with the Ethereum ecosystem.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey single-round MD5 KDF shipped by evp_bytestokey@1.0.3, pulled transitively by the browserify-crypto chain under ethereum-cryptography/eth-sig-util; retroactively weak and quantum-unsafe.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Password-hashing KDF in the shipped dev-toolchain dependency set; Grover-only quantum impact (modest). No first-party call site; changeable here via dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Generative-art seeding, not credential or key material: builds a fallback 64-hex 'DNA' string for the artgene.xyz iframe renderer when no DNA is passed (preview-only). The minted on-chain DNA is instead produced by keccak256(block.prevrandao, blockhash, tokenId) in the contracts. Kept as the deterministic weak-randomness flag; low security relevance at this site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves@1.3.0 provides secp256k1 ECDSA on the JS side of the same scheme the production contracts verify on-chain (ecrecover / SignatureChecker, reported as separate findings); ships in node_modules with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Bearer credential committed to the repo (X-API-Key header, line 20 of the same script) used to enumerate NFT holders from Moralis. Changeable here: rotate the key at Moralis and source it from env/secrets manager — the script already has dotenv in the toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Classical ECDH ships inside the local dev-blockchain toolchain (create-ecdh implements the crypto browserify ECDH for ganache's internals); no first-party ECDH/key-agreement use found. Shor-vulnerable if ever exercised; dev-only exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 shipped via @noble/curves@1.3.0, transitive under the @ethereumjs/@scure toolchain; no first-party import, the scheme ships in node_modules with the build.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 is the ECDSA/Recovery implementation used by the Ethereum JS toolchain — the same scheme the production contracts verify on-chain and the tests sign with (reported as separate first-party findings).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @noble/curves provides P-256 (plus secp256k1/ed25519) for the wallet/mnemonic stack; no first-party call site found — the project's own curve usage is secp256k1 via EVM ecrecover. Dev-toolchain dependency, changeable here via upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl (0.14.5 under ganache/truffle; web3's chain also pulls tweetnacl ^1.0.3 at line 2220) ships X25519 key agreement — Shor-vulnerable; part of the local-chain dev toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (Ethereum's pre-NIST-padding SHA-3 variant) is the project's domain hash: used first-party for Merkle allowlist leaves and DNA prediction in tests, and on-chain in the production contracts (reported separately); plus the keccak/keccak256 toolchain packages.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 packages of the Ethereum toolchain; PBKDF2 is also the KDF that turns the deployment mnemonic (hardhat.config.ts) into wallet keys inside ethers/hdwallet — that consuming use site is reported as a separate first-party finding.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js is the keystore key-derivation path of the Ethereum JS toolchain (wallet V3 keystore derivation); no first-party call site found. Grover-only quantum impact. Dev toolchain, changeable here via upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES ships in the dev-blockchain dependency tree; no first-party call site found. Dependency-inventory entry; dev-only, changeable here via upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 via @noble/hashes is the dev toolchain's hashing layer (used internally by the bip32/bip39 stack); no first-party call site found. SHA-256 is Grover-only affected — not PQ-urgent. Dependency inventory entry, dev-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 shipped in the @noble/hashes@1.3.3 library, transitive via @ethereumjs/@scure; available in the shipped library, no first-party call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: FIPS SHA-3 shipped via @noble/hashes@1.3.3 (padding distinct from Ethereum's Keccak-256, whose first-party use sits on the SHA-3 (Keccak) object and the Solidity findings); available in the shipped library.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
